response.sql: WITH team_totals AS (SELECT team_id, SUM(games) AS total_games FROM home_game GROUP BY team_id), stats AS (SELECT SUM(total_games) AS grand_total, AVG(total_games) AS avg_total FROM team_totals) SELECT t.team_id, t.total_games, t.total_games * 1.0 / s.grand_total AS share_of_total, t.total_games * 1.0 / s.avg_total AS ratio_to_avg FROM team_totals t CROSS JOIN stats s ORDER BY ratio_to_avg DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Totals are summed across all rows and seasons for each team_id, since home_game has one row per team per span and the request does not limit the years.
Missing games values are skipped by SUM and AVG. A team whose games values are all missing gets a NULL total, which is left out of the grand total and the average and sorts last.
